episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: Nicole had been the one to pick the school back when Naja was little.
Her husband, Faraji, had been reluctant to send Naja there.
He worried they'd be hurting her.
As Nicole, is this us experimenting on our child based on idealism?
But once they resolved to do it, Faraji was all in.
He threw himself into the school.
Both of them were committed to being involved, and Faraji ended up even more involved than Nicole.
They reassured themselves, knowing that if there were ways the school fell short, they could get Naja help, and they'd be there, watching.
